title: 5th-year student survey on AI in game development
author: ethanzxv
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’m a 5th-year student working on my final-year project about AI in game development, and I’m trying to understand how people are actually using these tools in real projects.

I’m especially interested in what tools you use, what you use them for, what genuinely helps, and also what frustrates you, slows you down, or simply doesn’t work well.

I made a short anonymous survey for my research. It should take around 4 minutes:

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScqkfLslaEA5hmfvKDCZxnlng9F3a8Zb1pWyR2yqsC-GpUYUA/viewform?usp=dialog](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScqkfLslaEA5hmfvKDCZxnlng9F3a8Zb1pWyR2yqsC-GpUYUA/viewform?usp=dialog)

Whether you use AI a lot, occasionally, or barely at all, your experience would be really useful.

Thanks!

replies.author: ethanzxv
replies.body: Thanks mate ! It will help me a lot !!!
